units: <cite ref="Zevachim 65b:3">Zeb. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>וכיון דמָצֵי לדם וכ׳</he> (not <he>דמצוי דם</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 1) and since he wrings the blood out, he does the act prescribed for the burnt-offering &c.
<cite ref="Ketubot 60b:12">Keth. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>מְמַצְּיָא ליה טפי</he> she will give him (her own child) more suck.
